units.source_text: 我知道自己的胃梦见的东西，是夹馅面包和豆馅糯米饼。

en.t: I knew that what my own stomach dreamed of was filled buns and bean paste rice cakes.

units.source_text: 即使在我的精神梦见宝石的时候，它依然是顽固地梦见夹馅面包和豆馆糯米饼……

en.t: Even when my spirit was dreaming of jewels, it still stubbornly dreamed of filled buns and bean paste rice cakes...

units.source_text: 反正人们试图勉强地理解我的犯罪时，夹馆面包会提供像样的线索吧。

en.t: In any case, when people try to force an understanding of my crime, the filled buns will probably provide a plausible clue.
